title: Event invite
brief:
An invitation to Orbit Summit.

- Preview text: "Join us December 4 in San Francisco."
- Hero image, full content width: https://assets.orbit.dev/img/event-hero.png (1200×600 file).
- Heading: "Orbit Summit 2026"
- Paragraph: "A day of talks and workshops on building for every surface."
- Three detail columns, side by side on desktop and stacked on phones, each a small label over a value:
  - "Date": "December 4, 2026"
  - "Time": "9:00 AM PT"
  - "Place": "Fort Mason, San Francisco"
- Button "Save your seat" linking to https://orbit.dev/summit, background #6d5efc, white text; on hover its background turns #4c3df0.
- Footer: "Orbit Labs, 500 Market St, San Francisco"
- Light grey page background (#f1f2f6), white 600px content card.
